principles.ai_role: research, source discovery, triage, cross-checking, summarization, QA, local discovery and recommendations
principles.human_role: editorial judgment, publication approval and high-risk decisions
principles.source_policy: Use public source metadata, headlines, summaries and links; never copy full articles. Cross-check important claims and link readers to original reporting.
principles.speed_policy: Prefer fast public feeds first, then discovery feeds; time out slow sources and continue.
principles.failure_policy: Never hide failures. Record source, workflow, stage, timestamp, latency and error message.

scouts.label: New Music Friday Scout
queries: new music OR album OR single OR EP OR mixtape

scouts.label: Culture Scout
queries: hip-hop culture OR music culture OR entertainment

scouts.label: Colorado Scout
queries: Colorado music OR Denver music OR Colorado concerts

scouts.label: Artist Watch
queries: artist announcement OR tour OR interview OR music video

eventSources.name: JamBase
eventSources.notes: Use event metadata and the event's official ticket destination; never invent ticket URLs.

ticketPolicy.rule: Every concert result should expose a Get Tickets action that sends the reader to the original event or authorized ticket provider for that specific event.
ticketPolicy.fallback: If no verified ticket destination is available, show the event without a ticket button rather than guessing.
ticketPolicy.privacy: Use voluntary city/state or city-level location only; never require an exact address.
